title.zh: 将利帕市的八打雁副区工程办公室升格为正式区工程办公室，名称为利帕市区工程办公室，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An act upgrading the Batangas Subdistrict Engineering Office of Lipa City into a regular District Engineering Office to be known as the District Engineering Office of Lipa City and appropriating funds therefor
title.orig: An act upgrading the Batangas Subdistrict Engineering Office of Lipa City into a regular District Engineering Office to be known as the District Engineering Office of Lipa City and appropriating funds therefor

text.en: The Batangas Subdistrict Engineering Office of Lipa City is hereby upgraded into a regular district engineering office.
The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations to implement this Act.

The Secretary of the DPWH shall include in its program the funding requirements for the operationalization of the Batangas Engineering District of Lipa City in the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
